entities.summary: USA Jet Airlines Flight 199 was a scheduled cargo flight from Shreveport to Saltillo Airport. On July 6, 2008, the McDonnell Douglas DC-9 operating the flight crashed on approach to its destination, killing the captain and seriously injuring the first officer who was taken to the hospital. As of 2026, this is the most recent incident involving a McDonnell Douglas DC-9.
